items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: That boy you seen at my house today, that's my son. Robert Williams, Jr.

ctx.x: Yes, sir. She, uh, plays piano now. Well, uh, I got some boys there. That boy you seen at my house today, that's my son. Robert Williams, Jr. Well, there's two of my boys, they're taking up this, uh, rock and roll. That, uh, beaters playing, uh, to keep it up, you see. So, uh, I think that's, uh, good money, uh, making tune with the playing in there, you see.
You know, I think in 1959 you told me that one of your sons was seven years old and he was a preacher. Is that the same one?
